FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A50
Dim high beams at 500 feet from an oncoming vehicle but at 300 feet when following one, so oncoming traffic gets the longer distance. [A50]
Why it matters: group_hint lighting-distances; prereq_hint sec03-F25; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F28, sec03-R02.
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A50
The 100-foot figure appears twice on this page, once for how far away brake lights must be visible and once for how early to signal before a turn or lane change. [A50]
Why it matters: group_hint lighting-distances; prereq_hint sec03-F29; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F29, sec03-F30, sec03-R01.
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A42
After a sale the seller files the report of sale within 5 days, while the buyer has 15 days to transfer ownership with the signed title. [A42]
Why it matters: group_hint vehicle-paperwork; prereq_hint sec03-F01; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F07, sec03-F08.
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A43
The single-person injury minimum is $25,000 and the multi-person minimum is $50,000, while property damage needs only $10,000. [A43]
Why it matters: group_hint insurance-minimums; prereq_hint sec03-F11; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F12.
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A51
All three hand signals use the left arm out the window, and only the hand direction changes: down for stop, straight out for left, up for right. [A51]
Why it matters: group_hint hand-signals; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F31.
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A49
Daytime running lights switch on when the car starts, but they are dimmer than headlights and leave the taillights dark. [A49]
Why it matters: group_hint lighting-rules; prereq_hint sec03-F25; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F25, sec03-F26.
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A42
Changing your driver license address leaves the vehicle address unchanged, so the two records must each be updated. [A42]
Why it matters: group_hint vehicle-paperwork; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec03-F06.
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A45
A blind-spot alert covers the next lane, not a car two lanes away that is also merging, so your own hazard awareness is still needed. [A45]
Why it matters: group_hint driver-assist-limits; prereq_hint sec03-F15; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F16, sec03-F19.
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A51
The seat rule keeps your chest at least 10 inches from the wheel for airbag space, while the headrest is set level with your ears for whiplash protection. [A51]
Why it matters: group_hint seating-position; prereq_hint sec03-F14; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F33.
Source: [A51 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A48
The minimum tire tread depth is 2/32 of an inch, while the correct tire pressure comes from the door-edge label or the owner's manual rather than a single fixed number. [A48]
Why it matters: group_hint tires; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F22, sec03-F23.
Source: [A48 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0048]
